description: Remind the signer of one sent request (native:<id>). At most one reminder per request per hour: a second call fails RATE_LIMITED with details.detail REMIND_COOLDOWN and details.retryAfterSeconds. Until in-app signing is available every call fails REQUEST_NOT_READY ("signing is not available yet") and nothing is sent or recorded. Receipt-backed: the same idempotencyKey replays the stored outcome. Requires agreements:write. Requires the agreements family flag and the agreements_native rollout; denials carry details.reason (AGENT_SURFACE_DISABLED, AGREEMENTS_DISABLED, TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED).

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key sent as the Idempotency-Key header. Same key + same payload replays the stored outcome (replayed: true); same key + a changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_agreements_requests_remind
